title: Willow Arcade
description: A D–C–A–G fragment from Willow Iridescence becomes a bright, unhurried five-beat song. A four-bar bass path returns beneath six-bar melodic breaths, so their beginnings move in relation to one another. Borrowed B-flat and C colours soften the D-major light. A later return keeps its tune but changes the ground, and the ending rests on a suspended dominant.
difficulty: Intermediate to advanced five-beat syncopation and overlapping phrase cycles
technical_note: Keep the short LH eighths light and hear its four-bar journey under the six-bar melodic phrases. The same melody in bars 13–14 receives different bass notes. Do not resolve the final suspended A harmony.

performance.note: The changing relation of four-bar bass cycles and six-bar melody gives gentle asymmetry. The short notes lean towards the long ones; keep the last suspended harmony open.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
